name: Night Owl
summary: A geometric night-owl mascot perched on the metric line: when the branch sags it swivels and hoots, and a human in the lit window rolls back.
look: Deep teal night, flat bold shapes, a teal owl with enormous eyes, amber beak and detached feet; warm lit windows for dashboards and humans; dawn gradient for the resolution.

components.name: Geometric owl
components.role: Pulse: teal body, huge eyes, amber beak and detached feet

components.name: Branch = metric
components.role: the chart line the owl perches on; the anomaly is a sag

components.name: Lit windows
components.role: dashboards as a glowing building nobody is watching

components.name: Eye states
components.role: open, wide, wink — the whole acting range

components.name: Anomaly card
components.role: rounded cream card with −18% and deploy meta

components.name: The lit window
components.role: the human at the laptop with the coral Roll back

motion.name: Land & settle
motion.how: squash-and-stretch on landing, 0.3 s back.out(2); contact frame on the downbeat

motion.name: Head swivel
motion.how: rotate 0→16° in 0.15 s power3.out with a 5 % body puff, on the beat after the anomaly

motion.name: Blink rhythm
motion.how: eyelid blink (0.12 s) every 2 bars on beat 4, wink on the final downbeat — the mascot keeps time with the track

story: Hook: a building of glowing dashboard windows, two eyes in the dark, 'And the drop still shipped on Friday.'. Reveal: the owl lands on the branch, eyes snap wide, 'Acme Pulse' rises. Proof: the branch (the metric) sags after deploy #2231, the owl swivels and hoots at a card with checkout −18% since 09:42, and a human in a lit window presses Roll back. CTA: dawn, the owl winks, 'Every metric. Every minute.' and Start free.
adapt: Choose an animal that matches your agent’s job (owl = watching, dog = guarding, bee = sorting), build it from simple shapes with big eyes, and seat it on your product’s key chart or timeline.

references.note: geometric characters with big eyes and detached feet, animated per moment
state machines to switch mascot poses from product events

fit.risk: A cute animal mascot can feel off-brand for serious infra buyers; keep the owl’s acting minimal (eyes and head only) and the proof card precise.
